description: Details submitted pursuant to reference 25/02646/FUL: external materials (3), landscaping (4), energy statement (5), dust management plan (10), site investigation (12), site contamination (13), SuDs (15) and construction traffic management plan (16) in respect of erection of a pair semi-detached two storey dwellinghouses with accommodation in roof space and rear and front dormers.
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: The details submitted are insufficient to satisfy the discharge of condition 3 (external materials), 15 (SuDS) and 16 (construction management plan) of planning permission ref: 25/02646/FUL due to unacceptable and insufficient information being provided in respect of the stated conditions. In the absence of such information the proposal is contrary to Policy CP24, CP28, and CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), Policies D4, T7, SI12 & SI13 of the London Plan (2021) and Policies DMD6, DMD8, DMD37, DMD49 and DMD61 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
